shortDescription: UPSSSC Office of the Advocate General Computer Cadre Main Examination 2026 under Advt. 20-EXAM/2026. Apply from 07 to 28 September 2026 after verifying PET-2025 eligibility.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has opened applications for the Office of the Advocate General Computer Cadre Main Examination under Advt. No. 20-EXAM/2026.

The post/examination includes Computer Operator Grade-A and Assistant Computer Operator. Only candidates who appeared in PET-2025 and have a valid score can apply. Registration starts on 07 September 2026 and the application submission deadline is 28 September 2026.

Important instructions

  • Verify post-wise vacancy and eligibility using the View option in the official advertisement.
  • Keep PET-2025 details and all required documents ready.
  • Submit the application before 28 September 2026 and save the confirmation.
